I counted the 22 W/E sites and left out the 12 horse sites. If the W/E sites are treated as horse camp, this entry is 21 primitive sites with no hookups (Pintail only) - then hookups should be electric 0 / water false, count 21, and fees surcharges {} .

WATERFRONT lead (apply.py doesn't write it): stored 'not waterfront' is too low. On Esri with campitks' coordinates the Pintail loop road runs along the peninsula's shore 10-25 m from the water, with the sites on its inland side (loop road between sites and water, so not on-water); campitks tags all 56 Boulder Bluff sites 'River/Lake View: Y', and the imagery shows a lake view across the road and a thin line of shore trees on the east and south sides. The equestrian loop is similar on its own point. Propose LAKEVIEW.

SITE COUNT vs KDWP: KDWP's area table says Boulder Bluff has 'Primitive Camping: 124' and 'Water, Electric: 24'; campitks lists only 33 primitive (21 Pintail + 12 horse) and 22 W/E (+1 W/E shelter). The other ~90 primitive sites KDWP counts are not on campitks (perhaps unreserved open camping) - unconfirmed, not counted.

MAX RIG 30: every Pintail and Equestrian site lists exactly 30 ft, as do several other El Dorado primitive loops (Sunset Cove, Patriot Lane, Veterans Point) - it looks like a default value rather than measured pads. It passes 23 ft either way.
PINTAIL CATEGORY: campitks lists Pintail's 21 under 'Looking For Category: Tent Site' only; they are gravel back-in pads with a 30-ft vehicle length. Treated as drive-in.
